scope: evidence body only; instructions, solved demonstrations, question and answer prefix preserved
scope_coordinates: half-open character offsets in the original unprefixed prompt
source_token_rule: tokens wholly contained in the body, intersected with the author's keep tokens
DT_reference: EOS only at source eligible tokens; preserve all other input tokens
faithfulness_deletion_scope: same source eligible tokens as the DT reference
faithfulness_score_view: positive_part, as in the released-v1 adapter
target: unchanged complete stored response plus terminal EOS
FT: live same-input K1 faithfulness and K3 recovery; no published CSV substitution
sentence_recovery: optional separate sentence/line-unit budget; mean positive score; whole units selected
